verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships an extensively documented Python API (AgentChat, core) covering agents, teams, tools, memory, and custom agent creation, installable via pip, letting an AI-native user programmatically drive every core capability (autogen-docs-1,3,10,11,12,13,14, autogen-gh-1,3). This is a code-level SDK rather than a REST/OpenAPI service, and the probes found no OpenAPI/llms.txt spec, but that's expected for a library-first product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of API stability across the 0.2→0.4 migration and no formal OpenAPI/REST contract for non-Python consumers.
